UPSTREAM: cfg80211: properly send NL80211_ATTR_DISCONNECTED_BY_AP in disconnect commit 80279fb7ba5b71981a60988b0307afa43f78f6b1 upstream When we disconnect from the AP, drivers call cfg80211_disconnect(). This doesn't know whether the disconnection was initiated locally or by the AP though, which can cause problems with the supplicant, for example with WPS. This issue obviously doesn't show up with any mac80211 based driver since mac80211 doesn't call this function. Fix this by requiring drivers to indicate whether the disconnect is locally generated or not. I've tried to update the drivers, but may not have gotten the values correct, and some drivers may currently not be able to report correct values. In case of doubt I left it at false, which is the current behaviour. For libertas, make adjustments as indicated by Dan Williams. Reported-by: Matthieu Mauger <matthieux.mauger@intel.com> Tested-by: Matthieu Mauger <matthieux.mauger@intel.com> Signed-off-by: Johannes Berg <johannes.berg@intel.com> BUG=chrome-os-partner:48225 TEST=autotest using brcmfmac with 4371 device Change-Id: Ifcada743fd40a86972c8bfa45f1b1169ebe35ac9 [arend@broadcom.com: also apply change to bcmdhd] Signed-off-by: Arend van Spriel <arend@broadcom.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/320990 Commit-Ready: Arend van Spriel <aspriel@gmail.com> Tested-by: Arend van Spriel <aspriel@gmail.com> Reviewed-by: Bernie Thompson <bhthompson@chromium.org>

dediprog: Use command 0x0B only on older SF100s As per e-mail with Dediprog, command 0x0B (which is not listed in the command spec) is used to set voltage level on older Dediprogs. SF100 V6.0.0 and newer as well as all SF600 programmers do not support it. This patch renames dediprog_device_init() to something more appropriate and adds comments for clarity, and only runs it conditionally if we cannot query the devicestring during init. Tested with SF100 V:5.1.5 and SF600 V:7.1.4 (with subsequent patches) BUG=none BRANCH=none TEST=Tested on SF100 and SF600 using dwmw2's patch (up next) Change-Id: I42de7d28401d7ad5be8fcf8a8c165e2614a45960 Signed-off-by: David Hendricks <dhendrix@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/293923
